name: Advanced Electrodynamics
summary: Graduate-level (Jackson-style) electrodynamics: boundary-value problems, radiation and the covariant theory.

topics.name: Boundary-value problems and Green's functions in electrostatics
Macroscopic media, dispersion and the Kramers-Kronig relations
Plane waves in conductors and dielectrics
Scattering and diffraction of electromagnetic waves
Covariant formulation: field tensor and four-potential
Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formulation of charges and fields
Radiation by moving charges: Lienard-Wiechert potentials and the Larmor formula
Synchrotron radiation, bremsstrahlung and Cherenkov radiation
Radiation reaction and the self-force problem
